pages.raw_title: Visit John Deere | John Deere US
pages.raw_meta: John Deere's attractions in Illinois and Iowa offer tractor, combine and construction experiences, plus educational opportunities for all ages to enjoy.
raw_blocks: See How We Live Up to the Legend

For nearly two centuries, we’ve partnered with those who work the land and shape the earth. Celebrate the incredible heritage and exciting future we're creating together by visiting one of our John Deere properties. Experience one of our exciting attractions that offer convenient hours and FREE admission. Brand fans can also shop for merchandise and find activities for kids below.

See why this attraction tops the list for many tourists to the Quad Cities and state of Illinois. The Pavilion offers guests cool insights into this iconic company and its innovations of yesterday and tomorrow.
Experience John Deere's homestead and a replica of the blacksmith shop in Grand Detour, Illinois where he created the plow that changed the course of history.
John Deere Tractor & Engine Museum
Witness the evolution from horse to horsepower in Waterloo, Iowa. Explore interactive displays and marvel at the classic machines and the progress they helped drive.
Your one-stop shop for all things Deere! The latest clothes, hats, gadgets, replicas and toys are waiting to make the perfect gift.
